# Epigram

> Open-Source, Free, and AI-Powered News in Short. Epigram delivers quick, clear AI-generated summaries of news from trusted sources, organized into a personalized, topic-based feed.

This is a placeholder llms.txt file. It will be expanded with detailed, LLM-friendly documentation in the future.

## Pages

- [Home](https://epigram.news/): The main personalized news feed with AI-powered summaries
- [Topics](https://epigram.news/topics): Browse news organized by topic
- [About](https://epigram.news/about): Learn more about Epigram and the team behind it
